digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter adapter — transport retry/error handling
propositions: transport.py exceeds the 800-line module-size cap (789 lines) with insufficient headroom to add new 429 retry policy logic

retry/error cluster (_connection_retry_exceptions, _jira_http_error_types, _as_backend_http_error, TlsVerificationError, _tls_verification_error, _with_connection_retry) must be relocated to a new retry.py module without changing behaviour or control flow
TlsVerificationError class and _tls_verification_error factory must move together to avoid circular imports between transport.py and retry.py
transport.py must re-export the six moved names via __all__ to preserve backward compatibility for existing importers like test_jira_dc_config_settings.py
all existing unit tests must pass unedited post-relocation, confirming behaviour preservation and that the change is a pure mechanical move
